home.metaTitle: SPOT — The events moving your city
home.metaDescription: What's happening in Douala, Yaoundé and Bafoussam, in a single app. Mobile Money payment, and a QR ticket issued only once the money has landed.
home.lede: What's happening in Douala, Yaoundé and Bafoussam, in a single app. You pay with Mobile Money, from the phone you already own. The ticket arrives with its QR code — and only once the money has landed.
home.payLede: No bank card to dig out, no wallet to top up. Pick your operator, confirm on your phone, and the ticket appears.
home.payRule: And if the payment fails, nothing happens at all: no ticket is ever issued before the operator has confirmed the payment. That rule governs everything else — no seat sold twice, no QR code loose in the wild, no argument at the door.
home.gateTitle: The doorman scans, the seat closes.
home.gate1Body: The QR code is scanned once. Shown a second time, it is refused — screenshots included.
home.gate2Body: Installed on your home screen, the app keeps your tickets within reach even when the connection falters.
home.gate3Body: The organizer watches admissions fill up live, without counting stubs by hand.
home.billTitle: Six reasons to go out this month.
home.billNote: Prices in FCFA, starting from. Douala · Yaoundé · Bafoussam.
home.coldTitle: The visitor who arrives from a shared link.
home.coldLede: They don't know SPOT. They came for one event. A discreet banner, shown above the feed and only to them, says in one line why the app is worth installing — and disappears the moment they sign in.
home.promoBody: Install SPOT: your seats stay available, even without a network.
home.outroLede: Add SPOT to your home screen: full-screen launch, tickets always within reach.
home.demoSentSub: Confirm the {operator} request on your phone.

organizers.metaTitle: SPOT — Organizers: fill your room, get paid in Mobile Money
organizers.metaDescription: Publish your event, sell seats online, scan admissions at the door and receive the money on your MTN or Orange number.
organizers.lede: Publish your event, sell seats online, scan admissions come the evening, and receive the money on your MTN or Orange number. No printer, no stubs, no recounting at midnight.
organizers.step1Body: Title, venue, date, ticket tiers and quotas. Ten minutes, from a phone. Nothing to install, nothing to sign.
organizers.step2Body: Your event gets its own public page. It travels on WhatsApp, it lives in the discovery feed, it can be found by city and by category.
organizers.step3Body: The doorman opens the scanner in the app. Each QR code passes once, and the admission counter updates live.
organizers.step4Body: You order the payout to your Mobile Money number. Funds leave the account that collected them — you never front anything.
organizers.costTitle: The only commission that exists is the one you set.
organizers.cost1Body: SPOT currently takes no platform commission on your sales. What the buyer pays, you get back.
organizers.cost2Body: If you open an affiliate campaign, you choose a percentage or a flat amount per seat. Nobody sets it for you.
organizers.cost3Body: MTN's and Orange's own fees, applied on collection and payout. SPOT does not mark them up.
organizers.costNote: Terms in force at launch. Any change would be announced before being applied.
organizers.boardEyebrow: What you see on your side
organizers.boardHeadline: A dashboard, not a night out.
organizers.board1Body: Seats sold and revenue for the day, read from the database, not from a spreadsheet.
organizers.board2Body: Who is already inside, how many are still outside, without a radio or a notebook.
organizers.board3Body: The detail per creator: seats attributed, commission due, payouts made.
organizers.board4Body: Every outgoing payment is traced, with its reason and its status.

creators.metaTitle: SPOT — Creators: your audience is worth more than a free post
creators.metaDescription: Join an organizer's campaign, share your link, earn a commission on every seat sold thanks to you — paid out in Mobile Money.
creators.title: Your audience is worth more than a free post.
creators.lede: You already talk about what's on in Douala or Yaoundé. Join an organizer's campaign, share your link, and earn a commission on every seat sold thanks to you — paid to your Mobile Money number.
creators.calcNote: A simulation. The real rate is the one of the campaign you join.
creators.step1Body: The organizer opens a campaign on their event and sets the commission: a percentage of the basket, or a flat amount per seat.
creators.step2Body: A promotion link that belongs to you. Story, WhatsApp status, bio — wherever your audience reads you.
creators.step3Body: When someone buys through your link and the operator confirms the payment, your commission is calculated and recorded.
creators.step4Title: You get paid in Mobile Money
creators.step4Body: You give the number you want to be paid on. The organizer orders the payout, and funds leave the account that collected them.
creators.ruleTitle: Your commission is locked the moment the money is collected.
creators.rule1Title: What is owed no longer moves
creators.rule1Body: The amount is calculated and recorded the instant the payment is confirmed, at the rate that applied that day. If the organizer lowers their commission the following week, your past sales are not recalculated.
creators.rule2Body: Nothing to front, no invoice to issue, no risk of ending up a creditor. Your only move is to give the number you want to be paid on.
creators.rule2Note: Every payout is traced, with its status — pending, paid, or failed and to be retried.
